item.belt_toolsdsc: A heavy duty belt that has pouches for tools, protecting them from getting wet.
item.climbing_helmetdsc: A fairly simple helmet designed to prevent climbing-related injuries and concussions. Very helpful for your continued survival.
item.clothdsc: A piece of cloth expertly weaved from plant fibers. A vital component in crafting clothing, as well as making high quality bandages.
item.clothrolldsc: Roll of cloth, used for tailoring.
item.combat_bootsdsc: A pair of heavy-duty leather boots, will last you quite a while and is fairly protective.
item.denim_jeansdsc: A simple pair of black jeans. Not very comfortable, but won't be effected by the harsh conditions of the caves.
item.denim_shirtdsc: A long-sleeve shirt meant to cover your upper torso. Provides good insulation and some protection. Very durable.
item.denimrolldsc: Roll of denim, used for tailoring.
item.gravity_backpackdsc: This looks and feels wrong. You can't decide if you should be disgusted or impressed by the level of craftmanship on display. Chews through batteries, a full charge only lasts half an hour and will explode in your face if it runs out of battery to boot.
item.hiking_backpack_hydrationdsc: A robust backpack used for carrying supplies in difficult conditions.. Just like your situation, actually. Seems to have a connection point for a hydration container.
item.hiking_backpackdsc: A robust backpack used for carrying supplies in difficult conditions. Just like your situation, actually..
item.hiking_bagdsc: A robust bag used for carrying life-saving supplies in difficult conditions. Just like your situation, actually..
item.hiking_beltdsc: A rugged belt to hold hiking tools, does not tear easily.
item.hiking_bootsdsc: A pair of rugged leather boots, designed for harsh conditions like the one you find yourself in.
item.hiking_glovesdsc: A pair of robust gloves designed for outdoor hikes.
item.hiking_hydration_containerdsc: A standard 3L container that can hold liquids. Attaches to the Hydration Hiking Backpack.
item.hiking_jacketdsc: A thick high-visibility jacket used for wilderness exploration, doesn't tear easy and keeps you warm.
item.hiking_jumpsuitdsc: A robust jumpsuit that can handle quite a few rough scratches and falls before even thinking about tearing. Mildly protective, and a bit uncomfortable, as a result.
item.hiking_legpouchdsc: A robust pouch used in difficult conditions to hold general purpose items, with a lot of straps to secure it to your leg.
item.hiking_materialpouchdsc: A robust material pouch used in difficult conditions to hold smaller, life-saving supplies.
item.hiking_medical_packdsc: A robust pack that is designed to hold medical supplies, typically containing emergency supplies for various hiking-related injuries.
item.hiking_packdsc: A robust pack used for carrying small bits and bobs. Fairly durable.
item.hiking_pantsdsc: Has even more pockets than regular cargo pants for a hoarder's dream. Built to last and is fairly durable and resistant to the elements.
item.hiking_reinforced_cooling_jumpsuitdsc: What was a standard hiking jumpsuit has been heavily reinforced with kevlar fibers all around common impact areas, preventing injuries associated with long falls. Significantly more heavy as a result. Additional pockets have also been sewn on. A body-wide liquid pouch of refrigerant has been sewn to the jumpsuit, providing excellent cooling capabliltes.
item.hiking_riggingdsc: A versatile rigging setup with several small pouches. Can hold most small things, but not many.
item.hiking_shirtdsc: A rugged long-sleeved shirt designed to withstand less-than ideal conditions. Provides good insulation & protection.
item.hydration_backpackdsc: A backpack used by joggers, walkers and causal explorers alike. Pretty useful in your situation.
item.hydration_containerdsc: A standard 1L container that can hold liquids. Attaches to the Hydration Backpack.
item.jacketdsc: A thick jacket meant to keep you warm in colder tempatures. Very durable.
item.juggernaut_body_armordsc: A professionally made modern-day plate armor set, will stop any hit 99% of the time. Extremely heavy, however. You will give out before it does.
item.juggernaut_bootsdsc: A professionally made modern-day plate armor set, will stop any hit 99% of the time. Extremely heavy, however. You will give out before it does.

item.juggernaut_helmetdsc: A professionally made modern-day plate armor set, will stop any hit 99% of the time. Extremely heavy, however. You will give out before it does.
item.jumpsuit_coolingdsc: A thick sloshy jumpsuit lined to the brim with refrigerant from ice-packs, the sheer amount provides a constant cooling effect without needing to regenerate. Utilizing this without any warm clothes to counteract the effect will result in quick hypothermia.
item.jumpsuit_mechanicdsc: What was a standard hiking jumpsuit has been heavily reinforced with kevlar fibers all around common impact areas, preventing injuries associated with long falls. Significantly more heavy as a result. Additional pockets have also been sewn on.
item.jumpsuitdsc: A simple plain-cloth jumpsuit that has a few pockets. Nifty!
item.kevlar_bagdsc: A reinforced bag designed to hoard a fair bit of things. Won't break easily.
item.kevlar_body_armor_powereddsc: Further enhanced alloyed armor, most of the internals have been replaced with a complicated array of wires, hydraulics and even a miniature shield system. The new housing for the power source has been made on the back, and as an added bonus, doubles as a small backpack.
item.kevlar_body_armor_reinforceddsc: This looks very familar.. Seems to be a reinforcement of existing Kevlar Body Armor, with thicker kevlar padding on connecting joints and heavier alloyed plates. Still room for further improvement, as this is all rather heavy..
item.kevlar_body_armordsc: A standard Type-III bulletproof set of body armor typically employed by various militaries, seems to have pockets for magazines. Will reliably stop four bullets.
item.kevlar_bootsdsc: A pair of heavy-duty kevlar-reinforced boots, it's not very comfortable but the protection it offers is unmatched. Rated for four bullets.
item.kevlar_glovesdsc: Movement is uncomfortable and stiff in these gloves, but it's better than getting your digits blown clean off. Rated for four bullets.
item.kevlar_helmet_heavydsc: A standard Type-III bulletproof helmet typically employed by various militaries, seems to have some slots for small items. Will reliably stop a bullet, equipped with a visor and side-plates for enhanced protection.
item.kevlar_helmetdsc: A standard type 1 bulletproof helmet typically employed by law enforcement agencies, seems to have a few slots for small items. Will probably stop a bullet.
item.kevlar_hydration_container_legdsc: Military-issue 8L container that can hold liquids. Attaches to the Kevlar Leg Pouch.
item.kevlar_hydration_containerdsc: Military-issue 8L container that can hold liquids. Attaches to the Kevlar Hydration Rugsack.
item.kevlar_legpouchdsc: Sturdy pouch that can hold quite a bit of things, with a lot of straps to secure it to your leg.
item.kevlar_pantsdsc: Not very comfortable and stiff when trying to move, but it'll save your legs from a bullet wound or two. Has a few pockets.
item.kevlar_rucksack_hydrationdsc: Military-issue pack that can hold all the equipment a solider on the go needs, and then some for the rest of his squad. Now comes with attachment points for liquids.
item.kevlar_rucksackdsc: Military-issue pack that can hold all the equipment a solider on the go needs, and then some for the rest of his squad.
item.kevlar_shirtdsc: A long-sleeve shirt made out of kevlar. Stiff and uncomfortable, it'll save you from a gunshot or two.
item.kevlar_vestdsc: A standard Type-I bulletproof vest typically employed by law enforcement agencies, seems to have some pockets for magazines. Will reliably stop two bullets.
item.kevlarrolldsc: Roll of kevlar material, used for tailoring.
item.leather_glovesdsc: A pair of leather gloves, not very insulating but protects your hands well.
item.leather_satcheldsc: A simple satchel that does not get in the way of backpacks. Can't hold very large items.
item.leatherdsc: Simple piece of processed leather. Used in tailoring.
item.leatherrolldsc: Roll of leather, used for tailoring.
item.lightweight_backpackdsc: A space-efficent backpack thanks to compartmentalization. Better than a normal backpack.
item.lightweight_bagdsc: A space-efficent bag thanks to compartmentalization.

item.refined_upper_torsodsc: Several slabs of metal strapped to your limbs and upper torso, fairly effective. Pretty heavy, however

item.sewingkitdsc: A simple kit full of sewing supplies to treat serious tears, or even make new clothing from scratch.

item.shirtdsc: Long-sleeve shirt meant to cover your upper torso. Provides good insulation and some protection.

item.sports_bottle_500mldsc: Does not actually contain Red Sports Drink.
